description: Add high-value, deterministic unit tests that lock in current behavior BEFORE any content/widget changes. Independent of FEAT-002/003 but MUST run first so later features cannot silently regress streaks, missions, unlock gating, scoring, or generator correctness. Covers PlayerProfile streak + missions, level-unlock across all game maps, completeLevel scoring boundaries, generator forLevel structure for 5 generators, and Number Quest problem math-correctness.
steps: Add test/player_profile_streak_test.dart: seed profile_last_day / profile_daily_streak via SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues, then PlayerProfile()..load() and recordPlayDay(). Cover same-day no-op, consecutive-day increment (seed last_day = now-1 day), gap/missed-day reset to 1 (seed last_day = now-3 days), and the previous-calendar-day rule that crosses month/year boundaries. Seed relative to DateTime.now() (recordPlayDay reads now()); document that the month/year case verifies the yesterday-string rule.

Add test/player_profile_missions_test.dart: Missions.forDay(day) determinism (same DateTime -> same 3 ids, length 3); reportMission clamps to target and ignores non-matching metrics; claimMission pays rewardCoins exactly once and only when complete (incomplete -> 0, complete -> rewardCoins and coins increase, second claim -> 0); midnight rollover (seed profile_mission_day = yesterday with stale progress/claimed, then reportMission rolls over). Drive claims by reading profile.todaysMissions and completing one via reportMission(m.metric, m.target). Mirror test/mission_rollover_test.dart; do not duplicate its assertions, add the clamp + claim-once focus.

Add test/level_unlock_test.dart: ONE parameterized test over the 5 GameProgressStore games (SafariState/SafariMap, WizardState/WizardMap, ClockState/ClockMap, MoneyState/MoneyMap, MemoryState/MemoryMap) asserting first level unlocked with no stars and level N locked until N-1 has >=1 star (seed <prefix>_level_<id> for the prev level, or award via completeLevel). Add a Number Quest case using GameState + WorldMap.allLevels + isLevelUnlocked(GameLevel).

Add test/complete_level_scoring_test.dart: using WizardState + PlayerProfile, drive completeLevel with correct/total hitting percent boundaries 49/50/69/70/89/90 (document the exact correct/total used), asserting stars 0/1/1/2/2/3. Verify keep-best (worse re-run does not lower stars), fastest-time only on a 3-star run with elapsedSeconds>0 and only when it improves, and never on a non-3-star run.

Add test/generators_test.dart: for number_quest/shape_safari/word_wizard/clock_hero/money_math, sweep sample levels + seeds via forLevel(level, random: Random(seed)). Assert exactly level.questionCount questions; type-aware distinct-choice counts (Word 4 Strings; Shape 4 ShapeChoices; Clock readClock/elapsed/findClock 4, SKIP setClock; Money countCoins/makeChange/makeAmount 4, whichMore exactly 2 piles with different totals; NQ 4 ints); correctIndex in range and pointing at the correct value; dedupe yields mostly-unique questions (distinct signatures >= count-1 or >=70%% of count, to stay non-flaky).

Add test/number_quest_problems_test.dart: sweep seeds 0..60 over WorldMap.allLevels (and generateRound(Difficulty.expert) to force division). Assert every Division question has a whole-number answer consistent with the parsed question, subtraction answers >=0, no negative choices anywhere, and the correct answer is present in choices.

Run the full suite; if a test reveals a REAL product bug, fix the SOURCE minimally (never weaken the test) with a one-line code comment and record it in findings. Then build web and commit this feature's work on feature/review-improvements.
acceptance_criteria: Six new test files exist under test/ and are deterministic (seeded Random, mocked SharedPreferences) — no flakiness across repeated runs.
`& "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" test` passes with the 15 original tests plus all new tests.
Any product bug surfaced by a new test is fixed in source (not by weakening the test) and noted in findings.
findings: Added 6 deterministic test files (seeded Random + mocked SharedPreferences): player_profile_streak_test, player_profile_missions_test, level_unlock_test, complete_level_scoring_test, generators_test, number_quest_problems_test. Full suite is now 45 tests (15 original + 30 new) and all pass; `flutter build web` prints `Built build\web`. NO product bug surfaced — all current behavior was already correct, so no source changes were made; later content/widget features (FEAT-002/003) can rely on these tests as regression guards. Notes for later features: (1) GameProgressStore star thresholds are 90/70/50 -> 3/2/1 stars and fastest time is recorded ONLY on a 3-star run with elapsedSeconds>0 that beats the prior record; do not alter without updating complete_level_scoring_test. (2) Level-unlock gate = first level always open, level N unlocked once level N-1 has >=1 star (seed `<prefix>_level_<id>`; Number Quest uses the `nq_` namespace). (3) Word Wizard missingLetter choices are single letters (correctIndex points at the missing letter, not the word), so distinct-choice assertions use choice count 4 but do NOT equate choices[correctIndex] with the word. (4) Clock setClock has no choice list (skipped in distinct-choice checks); Money whichMore has exactly 2 piles with different totals and correctIndex points at the richer pile. (5) generators_test uses a loose mostly-unique floor (>= count-1 or >=70%) to stay non-flaky against the ~25-try de-dup guard; expanding the Word Wizard word bank (TASK 1) will only make rounds MORE unique, so it stays green.
